output.body: Take f(x) = x^3 and look at its slope at x = 2. Suppose the rule is 'bring the exponent down in front and leave the exponent alone'. You can check any answer against the limit definition, (f(2+h) - f(2))/h as h shrinks, or by comparing f(2) = 8 with f(2.01).
